recommendation: Keep this no-change audit. If SDWG creates or updates a ClinicalDocument profile in a future project, title cardinality can be decided there; FHIR-7073 should not be re-applied to the current base Composition resource or to retired profile artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-7073 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 Composition issue asking what use case justified omitting composition.title. The approved resolution was to make Composition.title mandatory on the clinical document profile of Composition and solicit feedback during the DSTU period.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 6196. Git commit f5b05d7eb96e8e433c728013b8de38250fa2fea2 applied that revision by changing Composition.title from 0..1 to 1..1 in the then-active Composition spreadsheet, adding trial-use mandatory-title wording, and adding titles to Composition examples.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini still lists composition=Composition as an active resource, but the active [profiles] list has no ClinicalDocument profile and the old cda profile hook is commented out. The Composition core package currently references only the catalog profile path, not a ClinicalDocument profile. Later FHIR-34407 removed the ClinicalDocument Composition profile entirely. Later FHIR-32533 made base Composition.author and Composition.title optional, and the combined branch already contains the FHIR-32533 reconciliation that updates stale title prose. SDWG's 2025-01-30 minutes record that returning the clinical document profile to 1..1 was not necessary until clinical documents is updated.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The latest combined-branch source already reflects the later decisions: base Composition.title is 0..1 with non-contradictory profile-level guidance, the obsolete trial-use mandatory-title note has been removed, and there is no active core ClinicalDocument profile to constrain.
